utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Call the case please, Mr. Court Deputy.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is Case Number IT-02-60-T, the Prosecutor versus Vidoje Blagojevic and Dragan Jokic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Good morning, ladies and gentlemen. For this week's agenda, today and tomorrow we'll sit in Courtroom I. And in the morning on Wednesday and Thursday, we'll sit in Courtroom II. And on Wednesday we sit in the afternoon; Thursday in the morning. On Friday we come back to Courtroom I and sit in the afternoon. It's very complicated. Well, Mr. Stojanovic, could you tell us the pseudonym of this witness, please, for the sake of the record.

utterances.speaker: MR. STOJANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. We gave our -- today's witness a pseudonym, DW-1.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Are there any matters that the parties would like to bring to our attention at this stage? If none, could we go to closed session and bring in the witness, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: at 1.37 p.m., to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 13th day of July, 2004, at 9.00 a.m. 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
